description: EXT3 NF-M1 closure: per-row flip-identity QC on the committed 8.47M-row chirality catalog (p4_chirality.parquet). Flip-pass probabilities recovered via p_flip = 2*p_eq - p_raw per channel (channel-swapped: p_CCW^flip = 2 p_CW^eq - p_CW^raw, etc.). Residuals computed on all rows with complete raw+eq columns: (i) |sum of recovered flip probs - 1|; (ii) max excursion of any recovered flip prob outside [0,1]; (iii) max abs difference between the duplicated raw columns (_x vs _y merge legs).
conclusion: On the 88,278-row intersection where BOTH the raw_x and raw_y legs AND the equivariant raw companion columns are populated, all residuals are at float32 storage precision (max sum deviation 2.04e-7, ~1.7x float32 eps) and ZERO rows violate the identity beyond 1e-3. The catalog-wide QC pass on the union raw column set (full 8,474,531 rows including the 8,386,253 rows with only one raw leg populated) is reported separately in `ext4_fb1_flip_identity_qc_catalogwide.json` and is the source of the catalog-wide 2.9% any-channel / 1.57% CW-channel violator rate, 0.09 max bound excursion, and 4.3e-7 max sum deviation quoted in the paper (Appendix B.d). The intersection subset evaluated here therefore shows zero violators by construction; the catalog-wide rate and the HC dipole rerun under that catalog-wide flag (ext3_nfm1_hc_dipole_qc_rerun.json) carry the QC narrative.
